Resolves #18687
Refs #17844
Refs #18694

Six reveal-pin arms across two specs compared screenshots against goldens that no CI workflow re-mints, so each golden encoded whichever host and mode its minter used. They now read the header's box, geometry and surface as values, against an inline header captured in the same run — so the assertion carries its own baseline and nothing has to be re-minted.

The headed run is the receipt: headed and headless now produce the same outcome, 13 passed and 1 failed in both. Before this, family one's arms could not pass headed at all.

Evidence: L3 achieved — the six repaired arms pass headless and headed alike, each one reds under a seeded source change and greens on revert, and the single remaining red is reproduced on origin/dev's own copy of the spec. No CI workflow runs these Neural Link journeys, so L3 is the required tier. Residual: the tier-wide mode contract and threshold policy, Residual-Owner: #18694.

## What the two specs assert, and why it differs

Not one shared surface rule. I tried to write one twice and measurement refuted it both times; the source says why.

`src/tab/Container.scss:16` paints the inline variant only — `background-color`, `background-image` and an inset `box-shadow` hairline, all three token-valued. A reveal overlay's header is not the inline variant, so it receives none of them. What it does receive is its host's ground, deliberately: *"The surface deliberately stays the host's"* (`src/dashboard/Container.scss:147`). The dock example's host paints nothing there, so its reveal header is transparent. The Workstation's viewport sets `.neo-tab-header-toolbar { background-color: var(--workstation-panel-2) }`, so its reveal header paints that.

Both specs therefore assert box and geometry equality, and each asserts its own surface truth: the dock that its reveal header leaves the surface to the overlay, the Workstation that only the inline header carries the band gradient. Ground and divider colours are deliberately not asserted — pinning them would rot on every theme edit.

## Test Evidence

All runs `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<neo-agent-brain> NEO_E2E_PORT=8163 npx playwright test 'workstation/WorkstationNL\.spec' 'dashboard/DockPinCollapseNL\.spec' -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1`, at `9376d9dd55` rebased onto dev `474f4290c8`.

- Headless: 13 passed, 1 failed.
- Headed (`--headed`): 13 passed, 1 failed. Same arm, same error.

**AC-3 seed 1 — token.** `src/tab/Container.scss:17-19`, the inline variant's three surface hooks hardcoded to `transparent`/`none`/`none`, themes rebuilt (`build-themes -n -e esm -t all`, seed verified present in `dist/esm/css/src/tab/Container.css` before running): **all six repaired arms red**, 7 failed / 7 passed. The four dock arms at "while the inline header paints its own", both Workstation arms at "which the inline header does". The six unrelated arms stayed green.

**AC-3 seed 2 — geometry.** Same rule, the inset hairline replaced by `border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor` — the exact regression the source comment at `src/tab/Container.scss:11-13` warns against ("the header's box does not grow by a pixel ... and no height-asserting spec moves"). The four dock arms red at "reveal and inline headers share box and geometry", reporting height 26 against 25 and 33 against 32: one pixel, caught. The Workstation arms correctly stayed green — both of its headers already carry a 1px border, so this seed produces no divergence there, and seed 1 is what covers them.

**Revert.** Source restored, themes rebuilt, seed confirmed absent from the built CSS: back to 13 passed / 1 failed. Tree clean.

**The one red, in both modes and both runs.** `WorkstationNL:626` "the real tour keeps density, data, Canvas output, themes, rails, and identities live" — the root StateProvider count, 2 where the arm expects 1. Control: `git checkout origin/dev -- WorkstationNL.spec.mjs` and running that arm alone fails identically, same `Expected: 1 / Received: 2`. Pre-existing, untouched by this diff, which does not contain `rootProviderCount`.

`check-file-sizes --base origin/dev`: 3 paths evaluated, 0 violations, none of them in this diff.

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket's fix offered two routes for family one: declare a mode contract, or stop comparing pixels. Both families take the second — a mode contract states which host was right rather than removing the dependence on one.
- **#18687's AC-1 and AC-4 were scoped down, and #18694 filed to carry the remainder.** Both were drafted tier-wide while the ticket's own Out of Scope already excluded `PreviewLanguageDragPairNL`; the contradiction only surfaced when the repair was finished and neither AC could honestly be claimed. Rather than close the ticket over its own inconsistency or block a delivered change, the split is recorded in #18687's body and the tier-wide mode contract and threshold policy now have a live open owner. `PreviewLanguageDragPairNL` is, after this change, the only file left in `test/playwright/e2e` calling `toHaveScreenshot`.
- #17844 records the `WorkstationNL:626` red as "flagged to #18461". **#18461 is now closed**, so that pointer is dead and the red's only open owner is the census itself. Correcting the census line separately; noting it here because the number appears in this PR's evidence.

## Follow-up offered, not smuggled in

`box` and `readHeaderChrome` are now defined identically in both specs. They extract cleanly into `test/playwright/e2e/utils/`. Deliberately not done here: it would put a shared-helper move in the same diff as the assertion change, and a reviewer would have to separate them. Happy to file it.
